Rushing Weather Splits

How every ball carrier performs on runs under the game-day conditions below (QB scrambles and two-point tries are left out). Outdoor and open-roof games use the stadium's weather in that hour; dome and closed-roof games count as 70°F with no wind, rain or snow, and the humidity filter applies only to outdoor games.
